exposure: antenatally diagnosed congenital anomalies of the kidney and urinary tract (CAKUT)
cohort: Pregnant patients registered at a tertiary maternity hospital in a metropolitan city who were diagnosed with fetal urological anomalies.
finding: Antenatal and postnatal ultrasound are effective diagnostic tools for congenital urological anomalies; 84% of infants with prenatally diagnosed urological anomalies born in the study survived to 28 days of life.
